preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be between n-1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi and 1 <= ci <= 10000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices and have a positive flow volume.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m lines, one for each edge.

postconditions.expression: all(di in {0, 1} for di in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each output value must be either 0 or 1, indicating the direction of the flow.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if di == 0 and (ai == v or bi == v)) == sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if di == 1 and (ai == v or bi == v)) for v in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of incoming flows must equal the sum of outgoing flows.
